🧭 Local travel essentials
Getting around
Mi Macro Periférico(Mi Macro Periférico, BRT) · Tren Ligero(Tren Ligero, light rail) · Mi Tren(Mi Tren) + local buses. Operated by state agency SITEUR. World Cup Korea match venue Estadio Akron(Estadio Akron, Zapopan outskirts) is about 10 minutes on foot from Estadio Chivas station on Mi Macro Periférico via Andador Chivas pedestrian path. Fare approximately 11 pesos (~$1 USD or less).
See more
Late-night transit
Mi Macro and Tren Ligero last trains are the constraint — Mi Macro Calzada ~11 PM, Periférico main lines ~11:30 PM (some secondary lines 12:30 AM), then service ends (no 24-hour operation). If the match ends after 10 PM, you'll likely miss the last train; relying on Uber or DiDi is realistic. Given the outlying location, expect surge requests and higher fares immediately after — factor that in. For late-night travel, use app-based rides or official taxis (avoid street hails).
Payment
Downtown megastores, chains, and hotels accept cards and mobile payments (Apple/Google Pay) well, but street vendors, small shops, and markets are cash-focused. Cash remains widely used across Mexico — carry a reasonable amount in local currency.
Currency & exchange
Mexican peso (MXN). Exchange or ATM withdrawals recommended given the significant cash use. ATMs and exchange services are widely available at airports and downtown (avoid carrying large amounts).
Language
Spanish. English is moderately useful in tourist and venue zones, but less so elsewhere — translation apps and ride apps (most have English UIs) are handy.
Local apps
Uber (Ride-hailing (top choice for travelers, English UI)) · DiDi (Ride-hailing (widely available in Mexico, often cheaper than Uber)) · Google Maps (Mi Macro, Tren Ligero, and bus routes)
Late-night transit
Uber (Late-night app rides are standard (English UI, upfront pricing, confirm driver and plate) — safest and most secure for travelers.) · DiDi (Alternative: compare ride-hailing apps for rates (widely available in Mexico, both reliable))  📶 eSIM ↗
How to book
Skip the Estadio Akron main entrance and plaza — walk 1–2 blocks away to request rides. If Uber's slow, try DiDi to spread demand. Given the outlying location, request a ride before the match ends, or catch the last Mi Macro Periférico train if timing allows.
🛡️ Safety
Emergency Number
All-in-one emergency (police, fire, ambulance) 911 · Tourism Support 078(Ángeles Verdes)
Travel Alert
U.S. State Department, Jalisco, Level 3 (Reconsider Travel—cartel activity, kidnapping). However, no travel restrictions within Guadalajara metropolitan area itself. Avoid intercity travel at night and outlying areas; use app-based or licensed taxis (updated 2026-05-29; World Cup guidance added).
Tourist Police
Federal tourist assistance: Ángeles Verdes (Green Angels) 078 (English available, 24 hours) — road and tourism support. 911 for police and ambulance.
